goal: GOALIE.md E6 / VISION.md HSP-21: every VISION.md HSP acceptance row claimed exactly once, with named on-disk evidence, one-to-one artifact traceability, and one acceptance command that fails on any missing, duplicated, unordered, or over-claimed row.

traceability_scope.note: One-to-one traceability is enforced over proof artifacts, not implementation modules. Every path matching the globs below must be owned by exactly one row (as a `tests` or `evidence` entry); a row may also cite another row's artifact under `supporting`, which is never ownership. The globs must end in `**/*`, not `**`: pathlib's `**` matches directories only, so a `migration/evidence/**` glob silently matches zero files and disables the orphan check entirely.
traceability_scope.src_exclusion_reason: HSP-21 asks that every implementation artifact trace to exactly one row. That is not honestly achievable for src/: the sealed slice manifests already assign the same module to different rows (src/houndd/journal.py is HSP-05 in tests/acceptance_slice1.json and HSP-20 in tests/acceptance_slice3a.json; src/houndd/cursor.py is HSP-20 in slice2a and HSP-08 in slice3a), because a module genuinely serves several acceptance rows. Forcing a single owner per module would be an invention, so this manifest claims one-to-one over proof artifacts only and records the residual gap under HSP-21's `missing`.
